Không cho phép sửa khi tem đã được nhập kho         ---------------------------------------------------         IF EXISTS (             SELECT 1              FROM dbo.B30BizDocTemLot             WHERE ItemLotCode = @_ItemLotCode               AND IsInput = 1         )         BEGIN             RAISERROR(N'Không thể thay đổi số lượng vì tem đã được nhập kho.', 16, 1);             ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;             RETURN;         END          ---------------------------------------------------         -- 2. Lấy quy cách đóng gói         ---------------------------------------------------         SELECT TOP 1             @_MinQuantity = ISNULL(NULLIF(Quantity,0),1),             @_MaxQuantity = ISNULL(MaxCloseQty,0)         FROM dbo.B20ItemQuyCach         WHERE ItemCode = @_ItemCode            AND CustomerCode = @_CustomerCode;          SET @_MinQuantity = ISNULL(@_MinQuantity, 1);         SET @_MaxQuantity = ISNULL(@_MaxQuantity, 0);          ---------------------------------------------------         -- 3. Vô hiệu hóa tem cũ         ---------------------------------------------------         UPDATE dbo.B30BizDocTemLot         SET IsActive = 0,             ModifiedBy = @_ModifiedBy,             ModifiedAt = GETDATE()         WHERE ItemLotCode = @_ItemLotCode           AND IsActive = 1           AND IsInput = 0;          ---------------------------------------------------         -- 4. Trường hợp KHÔNG có tem pallet         ---------------------------------------------------         IF (@_MaxQuantity = 0)         BEGIN             SET @RemainingQty = @_Quantity;              WHILE @RemainingQty > 0             BEGIN                 SET @CurrentSmallQty =                     CASE                          WHEN @RemainingQty >= @_MinQuantity                             THEN @_MinQuantity                         ELSE @RemainingQty                     END;                  EXEC dbo.usp_upd_B30BizDoc_TemLot_New                     @ItemLotCode = @_ItemLotCode,                     @ItemCode = @_ItemCode,                     @Quantity = @CurrentSmallQty,                     @CreatedBy = @_CreatedBy,                     @ModifiedBy = @_ModifiedBy,                     @ParentId = 0,                     @TemBarCodePL = NULL;                  SET @RemainingQty = @RemainingQty - @CurrentSmallQty;             END         END         ---------------------------------------------------         -- 5. Trường hợp CÓ tem pallet         ---------------------------------------------------         ELSE         BEGIN             SET @RemainingQty = @_Quantity;              WHILE @RemainingQty > 0             BEGIN                 SET @CurrentPalletQty =                     CASE                          WHEN @RemainingQty >= @_MaxQuantity                             THEN @_MaxQuantity                         ELSE @RemainingQty                     END;                  -- Tạo tem pallet                 EXEC dbo.usp_upd_B30BizDoc_TemLot_NewPL1                     @ItemLotCode = @_ItemLotCode,                     @ItemCode = @_ItemCode,                     @Quantity = @CurrentPalletQty,                     @CreatedBy = @_CreatedBy,                     @ModifiedBy = @_ModifiedBy,                     @TemBarCodePL = @TemBarCodePL OUTPUT,                     @ParentId = @ParentId OUTPUT;                  -- Tạo tem thường thuộc pallet                 SET @RemainingSmallQty = @CurrentPalletQty;                  WHILE @RemainingSmallQty > 0                 BEGIN                     SET @CurrentSmallQty =                         CASE                              WHEN @RemainingSmallQty >= @_MinQuantity                                 THEN @_MinQuantity                             ELSE @RemainingSmallQty                         END;                      EXEC dbo.usp_upd_B30BizDoc_TemLot_New                         @ItemLotCode = @_ItemLotCode,                         @ItemCode = @_ItemCode,                         @Quantity = @CurrentSmallQty,                         @CreatedBy = @_CreatedBy,                         @ModifiedBy = @_ModifiedBy,                         @ParentId = @ParentId,                         @TemBarCodePL = @TemBarCodePL;                      SET @RemainingSmallQty = @RemainingSmallQty - @CurrentSmallQty;                 END                  SET @RemainingQty = @RemainingQty - @CurrentPalletQty;             END         END          FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO              @_ItemLotCode, @_ItemCode, @_CustomerCode,             @_Quantity, @_CreatedBy, @_ModifiedBy, @_RequestDate;     END      CLOSE cur;     DEALLOCATE cur; END "

column1: dbo,STOCKTP,trgupdatetblDoctem,SQL_TRIGGER,0," CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[trgupdatetblDoctem]    ON  [dbo].[STOCKTP]     AFTER INSERT, UPDATE AS  BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM inserted) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM deleted)     BEGIN         IF TRIGGER_NESTLEVEL() <= 1         BEGIN             UPDATE t             SET CASX = TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(t.LOT, 12, 1) AS INT)             FROM [B7R2_FCC].[dbo].[STOCKTP] t             INNER JOIN inserted i ON t.SP = i.SP AND t.LOT = i.LOT             WHERE LEN(t.LOT) >= 12 AND (t.CASX IS NULL OR t.CASX = 0);         END     END      DECLARE @slphieu int, @slle int;      IF (UPDATE(SLNHAP) OR EXISTS(SELECT * FROM INSERTED))     BEGIN         -- Kiểm tra xem có bản ghi nào khớp với B20Item và MinCloseQty hợp lệ (> 0) không         IF EXISTS (             SELECT 1              FROM B20Item              JOIN inserted ON B20Item.Code = inserted.PART              WHERE ISNULL(B20Item.MinCloseQty, 0) > 0         )         begin             -- Sử dụng NULLIF để tránh chia cho 0 hoặc NULL             SELECT @slphieu = FLOOR(inserted.SLNHAP / NULLIF(B20Item.MinCloseQty, 0))              FROM B20Item              JOIN inserted ON B20Item.Code = inserted.PART;              IF @slphieu IS NOT NULL AND @slphieu > 0             BEGIN                 UPDATE TOP(@slphieu) tbl_DocTem                 SET IsCreate = 1                  FROM tbl_DocTem                 JOIN inserted ON tbl_DocTem.SP = inserted.SP AND tbl_DocTem.IsCreate is NULL;             END              SELECT @slle = inserted.SLNHAP % NULLIF(B20Item.MinCloseQty, 0)              FROM B20Item              JOIN inserted ON B20Item.Code = inserted.PART;              IF ISNULL(@slle, 0) <> 0             BEGIN                 UPDATE tbl_DocTem                  SET IsCreate = 1                  FROM tbl_DocTem                 JOIN inserted ON inserted.SP = tbl_DocTem.SP AND tbl_DocTem.SLTem = @slle AND IsCreate is NULL;             END         end     END      IF (UPDATE(SLCONLAI))     BEGIN         UPDATE STOCKTP          SET SATUS = 1          FROM STOCKTP         JOIN inserted ON STOCKTP.SP = inserted.SP AND STOCKTP.LOT = inserted.LOT         WHERE STOCKTP.SLCONLAI = 0;     END END "
